classifications.application: Explicit application service/capability, aggregate registry with identity, or application foreground display.
classifications.fixed-owner: Fixed owner facade, membership bridge, or private built-in module with contextual pyzo replacement.
classifications.legacy: Compatibility archive/preset, or legacy fallback bypassed by the peer identity/provenance service.
classifications.bootstrap: Application initialization/seed/import/shutdown; archived values are not peer contextual authority.
classifications.test-example: Test-only smoke/demo or unsupported reference extension; excluded from product contextual routing.
classifications.receipt: Application resource service guarded by captured owner/view/kernel generation receipts.

CONTEXT.invariant: Facades resolve owner identity; mutable contextual trees/history remain local; shared exceptions explicit; retire disconnects callbacks.

TOOLS.invariant: ScopedToolManager replaces pyzo in each private module and relative dependency before constructing widgets; missing resources remain empty; ten-tool live replay and retired-module/callback assertions.

IDENTITY.invariant: Application registries are explicitly indexed by invoking widget/view/owner or aggregate all resources; no contextual value is chosen through foreign foreground. Main native lifecycle/effects controls cover these bridges.

PROVENANCE.invariant: Native service uses exact owner/view/resource/request/kernel receipt before dispatch/publication; old global path executes only without peer service. Breakpoint aggregate notifications are filtered by fixed shell owner.

INGRESS.invariant: Resolve application at GUI dispatch; choose eligible MRU or one default only for empty set; exclude closing/failed/disposed/exit; file modal rechecks owner epoch. Legacy paths resolve current legacy manager.

COMMANDS.invariant: Menus capture invoking context/source and pass it to application command service; command descriptors/keymap are shared capabilities. Qt style/theme/language effective state is explicitly application-wide; requests local.

LIFECYCLE.invariant: Startup/archive compatibility and explicit application exit iterate resources; peer restore is modern document/owner authority, legacy config is an import. Honest test exit enforced; peer/legacy smoke exercised.

COMPATIBILITY.invariant: Legacy named-view presets/windows and PDF default constructor remain compatibility APIs. Peer preset topology operates through the explicit primary workspace session, not profile copy or concurrent-owner selection. Invoking PDF menu supplies editor/parent explicitly. Example extension has no workspace_api declaration and is refused in peer mode.

CAPABILITY.invariant: Diagnostic stream, library/theme/install files, keyboard mapping, initial onboarding/language are explicitly application capabilities; local tools bind metadata to explicit editor, and requested capability differences are reported.

SMOKE.invariant: Built-in _test routines run only under test callback/--test; screenshot example is not product ingress. Peer/legacy and injected negative controls establish teardown/exit behavior.

MACOS.invariant: Shared native menu callbacks resolve owner at invocation; owned menus/modal groups retain ancestry. Editor metadata indexes its runtime. Modern restart maps retained views/tools independently of fresh shells, reuses an empty host only within its owner and restores surviving frame geometry. Physical evidence plus live owner/menu and two-process topology/epoch assertions.

PROFILE.invariant: Fresh startup is separate from legacy import. Legacy file/main/history markers address the actual restored host; compatibility editor lists survive peer shutdown. Menu pin mutations update the bound view identity, restored pins read that descriptor, and committed peer close cannot open a legacy prompt. Pristine, QtADS and peer profile/restart/fallback controls assert effects and unchanged source bytes/timestamps.
